scope: Independent whole-island visual review of corrected construction hosts and completed assembly. No per-part admission gate.
summary: The previously reported raw-funnel interference and shrinking/missing geology hosts are resolved in the supplied construction frames. Completed hall and surface remain coherent. This is acceptance of those concrete corrections and the assembled presentation, not a 10/10 reference-likeness or mobile-performance claim.

resolved.finding: At t53, t75 and t100 the solid raw funnel no longer cuts through the robots, seats or rising ribs. The open cavity provides a readable construction space.
The rear and side rock enclosure stays full size while architectural ribs and furniture appear. The prior broad bands of floating cliff foliage and boulders inside the cavity are absent.
The presidential area remains clear of the radial bowl; upper approach rails remain present; the finished t134 hall is consistent with the static hero capture.
The surface capture places shoreline boulders against the cliff envelope instead of exposing them inside the room.

nonblockingResiduals.finding: Two rectangular cyan openings remain near the upper sides of the unfinished cavern until the lift/gallery assembly covers them. They read as unlined shaft apertures. A dark interior sleeve would improve the unfinished state, but this does not recreate the former broad enclosure failure.
Architecture and seating still visibly scale into place, including tiny seats at the edges during t100. The robot build is legible as a stylized reveal rather than detailed piece-by-piece assembly.

The scene is substantially simpler than the approved concept art: smooth grouped tree crowns, repeated sparse vines, pale flat stone surfaces and limited material/lighting detail. These differences preclude a perfect likeness or finish claim.

limits: Review inspected the six listed raw browser PNGs at their supplied camera and lighting, not every intermediate frame or camera angle.
Earlier independent replay and late-completion repros passed after the sequencing fix; runtime tests were not rerun for this image-only correction review.
The earlier phone harness captures established framing only. These desktop stills do not prove full-Pilot phone performance, low-quality rendering, temporal smoothness or pointer interactions.
No gameplay, geometry, runtime or capture files were edited by the reviewer. Only this report was written.
